persona: Easy-going. Calls the policy 'house insurance'. Bought the record player with a whole record set-up before Christmas, so the tax invoice runs to two pages; only scanned the first page and can send the second page later.
initial_message: Hi, I need to make a claim on my house insurance. On Wednesday 9 September I was vacuuming and the vacuum cord caught the leg of the sideboard, and my record player fell off onto the floor. The tone arm is bent and the lid is cracked. I've got a photo and the invoice from the shop.

facts.loss.description: Tone arm bent, clear dust cover cracked, and the platter now wobbles when it spins

design.notes: Plan feature none with condition missing_page. The tax invoice is the only proof of ownership, a required material for contents on main (incident_photo and proof_of_ownership). It prints "Page 1 of 2"; page 2, with the last line, the total paid and the payment method, is missing. The purchase date, customer and the turntable line with its serial number are on page 1. The missing page is on the invoice rather than a repair quote because main does not require a repair quote for contents. The claimant names the wrong product (house insurance) for a contents item.

triage.rationale: Accidental damage to one turntable at the insured address, nobody hurt, photo supplied, policy on file. The only proof of ownership, the tax invoice, is missing its second page (total paid and payment method), so required material is incomplete and someone must chase page 2. The largest known amount is the item value, NZD 1,690, under the threshold; the other lines on the invoice are items that were not damaged. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: Purchase date 20 December 2025, printed on the retained page 1, is before the incident on 9 September 2026

quote_before_loss.basis: No quote or assessment in the pack

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (1 August 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2021-08-01, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.
